hero.label: SALONS, GYMS & MEMBERSHIP
hero.headline: The clients who stopped coming are your fastest money.
hero.subhead: Most salons are busy but barely profitable. A new client is expensive to win. One who already knows you is not. We find who has drifted, reach each of them personally and get them back through the door.

problems.title: Clients come once and don't return.
problems.text: A healthy salon keeps 60% to 70% of its clients. Most UK salons fall below that.

problems.title: No usable client data.
problems.text: Details sit in a booking system or a notebook, and nobody can say who has stopped coming.

problems.title: Busy but not profitable.
problems.text: One in five hair and beauty businesses is running at a loss, and nearly three quarters are on thin margins.

problems.title: Texts that get ignored.
problems.text: 81% of people ignore messages that aren't relevant to them.

problems.title: Social media done by hand, or not at all.
problems.text: Posting and replying take time nobody has between clients.

usualFix: Bulk text services and Mailchimp send the same message to your whole list. Most people ignore it, some unsubscribe, and you have just offered a discount to clients who would have paid full price. We do it the other way round. We work out which clients have drifted and are worth winning back, send each one a message that fits them, give them a reason to book now, and show you who actually walked back in.

faqs.q: We already send texts from our booking system. What's different?
faqs.a: Those go to everyone. Ours go only to the clients worth winning back, with an offer that suits each one, and you see who returned.

faqs.q: Do we have to change our booking system?
faqs.a: No. We work from the client list you already have.
No. Fewer people are contacted, each message is personal, and every one has a way to opt out.

faqs.q: How soon will we see clients come back?
